side-lunge.criteria: Two dumbbells at sides; lateral step, sit into the stepping hip while keeping the other leg extended; push back to standing. Demonstration repeats one side, then switch outside clip.

kettlebell-lunge.criteria: Two kettlebells at sides; forward step, controlled upright descent, push front foot back to starting stance. Knee approaches rather than touches floor; same-side demonstration.

dumbbell-jump-squat.criteria: Two dumbbells at sides; squat, extend into a small jump, land with knee and hip flexion, then stand. Slow illustrative playback, not a real-time exercise cadence.

sourceKind: Original procedural skinned demonstration; not copied footage.
limits: Eight-second illustrative cycle, not individualized loading or physiological timing. Joint constraints and frame review do not certify exhaustive skin/garment collision. No actual-phone or production verification.
